Completed batch 24 with 15 items: 10 on the A page and 5 examples or counterexamples on the B page. I added [the finite event-conditioning lemma](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-finite-event-conditional-expectation-formula.md) to supply the conditioning and finite-partition results used by the two-stage proofs. Its sources include Grinstead and Snell’s [Chapter 4](https://chance.dartmouth.edu/teaching_aids/books_articles/probability_book/Chapter4.pdf) and [Chapter 6](https://chance.dartmouth.edu/teaching_aids/books_articles/probability_book/Chapter6.pdf).

All 15 items have `ready` records, and all 15 record hashes validate. These are authoring-readiness records, not independent approval.

**Scoped checks passed:** proof contracts 15/15; proof layout 15 items and 42 steps with 0 defects; phase precheck 11 proof-bearing items with 0 failures; focused dependency, content-policy, render, prose and coverage checks with 0 errors; source fetch verification 8/8.

The assigned dependency levels match the recomputed graph, including batch 12’s level-1 supplier. The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/statistical-models-experiments-62-batch-24.notes.md) record the variance-formula sample-size guards for owner reconciliation: the source formulas’ denominators require arm sizes of at least two, which the plan’s point-estimator ranges alone do not ensure.

The full-run dependency check still reports empty inventories in batch 47 and stale levels in batches 16 and 45; it reports no batch-24 errors. The shared batch-level scheduling artifact should be recomputed by the owner after manifests settle. I left it unchanged.
